fact: President Sassou-N'guesso promulgated on 20 August 2020 the law authorising Congo to ratify the AU Convention on cybersecurity and personal data protection, after parliament adopted the cybercrime and cybersecurity law in June 2020 that transposes regional and community norms.
title: Le Congo Brazza ratifie la Convention de l'Union africaine sur la cybersécurité et la protection des données à caractère personnel
